message: Thanks. A few questions: Which state do you live in? Roughly how much does the household earn from work per year? How much Social Security does your dad get per year? Any other income (pensions, interest, etc.)? Does anyone have a disability? Roughly how much is in bank accounts and investments? Does anyone get health insurance through a job? What do you pay for rent or mortgage each month?
reply: the District of Columbia. Around 16 thousand a month. I don't really know. Somewhere between 110 thousand and 170 thousand a year. I'd have to check. $147,900. Yeah. Somewhere between $1,000 and $1,700 a month.

summary: DC household of 2 (adult plus 72-year-old father), no kids. Reported income is roughly $110k-$190k a year, and assets are about $148k. That is well above the limits for SNAP, Medicaid, SSI and the ACA premium tax credit (400% FPL cap, about $84k for 2 people). They also have no children, so WIC, TANF, CHIP, CTC and school meals don't apply. EITC doesn't apply at this income either. Some answers were ambiguous, but no reading of them would make the household eligible for any programme.
